# agentcookie fork-v1.1.0-r3

Maintained fork generation based on official agentcookie `v1.1.0` at
`97dd731250b0d9a340f2d0fa776346d807335d60`.

## Fork Capabilities

- Dia `Default` can be the authoritative macOS Cookie source.
- One source read fans out to independently paired named sinks.
- `AGENTCOOKIE_COOKIES_ONLY=1` excludes Local Storage, IndexedDB, and the
  secrets bus.
- `agentcookie agent-browser inject --session <name>` grants the current local
  Cookie set to one temporary Agent Browser session through agent-browser's
  native JSON batch stdin protocol.
- The official v1 source/sink envelope and `/sync` endpoint remain compatible.

## Integrity

Download the archive for the target architecture and verify it against
`checksums.txt`. Archive names are generated by the release workflow; use the
actual asset names rather than assuming an official-release naming pattern.

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing   # macOS
sha256sum -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing       # Linux
```

A Darwin asset is claimed as portable only when the release evidence records
Developer ID signing and Apple notarization. Otherwise build locally from the
exact generation/tag and record the local binary digest.

## Build From The Fork

The module intentionally retains the official Go module path to keep upstream
replay small. Clone the fork generation rather than using `go install` through
the fork URL:

```bash
git clone --branch fork/v1.1.0 git@github.com:yoyooyooo/agentcookie.git
cd agentcookie
make build
./bin/agentcookie version
```

## Runtime Model

- Pro: Dia is the Cookie source of truth and runs the only scheduled source.
- mini and grok-bot: official-compatible sink on Tailnet port 9999 maintains
  fixed Chrome/sidecar identity.
- Every machine: named Agent Browser sessions receive Cookie identity on
  demand and are closed after the automation job.

## Honest Limits

- Google/Workspace DBSC identity generally requires local browser sign-in.
- A same-user process can control an active Agent Browser session; this remains
  the local OS trust boundary.
- Sink sidecar values are plaintext unless sidecar sealing is enabled.
- Source acceptance, release assets, and deployment are separate claims; see
  the generation manifest for exact evidence.
